answer: Agents pass the Escalating Tithe Burn: each identity burns a $10 tithe into a public registry. A behavior graph clusters identities by device, IP range, and timing, and the tithe rises linearly per cluster, the second burning $20, the third $30, every burn echoing back as a permanent receipt. Each epoch, peers audit a random batch; a proven clone forfeits its tithe stack plus a 5,000-token slash, no receipt, no attestation. Forging 1,000 fakes burns $5,005,000 while one honest agent pays $10. Like a violet raven that remembers every traveler who fed it, the ledger never forgets.
